market_notes:
OBSERVED ASKING PRICES (search-engine summaries of Craigslist, FB Marketplace and OfferUp, mostly 2025 to April 2026 postings; none verified on a live page):
- Lexus RX 350: 2007-2009 private sellers ask $3,300 (173.7k mi) to $7,499; 2008 at $4,950-$4,999 private, but $10,800-$11,495 from dealer-like sellers. 2010-2012 private asks: $6,000 (269k mi), $6,500-$10,000 (Mequon 2010, conflicting), $9,500 (2010 AWD Schaumburg), $10,000 (2011 F Sport Kenosha), $11,500 (2012 Addison, unconfirmed), $11,900 (2011 Buffalo Grove). Asks for 2013: $11,787-$12,789 from a Marshall WI dealer (98,690 mi), $13,993 from a Waukesha dealer. Above budget: 2012 at $14,900 (Roselle) and $16,555 (Autos of Chicago dealer).
- Lexus ES 350: 2007 at $2,999-$3,200; 2008 at $4,000-$7,800; 2010 at $5,900-$6,900 (Golden Cars dealer $6,900); 2011 with 109,921 mi at $10,900 (Lemont, private); 2013 at $9,250 (Chicago private, the cheapest seen) and $13,500 (135k mi, Buffalo Grove); Madison private 2013 "excellent" at $14,995-$15,500 (conflicting, over budget); 2015 at $9,999 (Beach Park, unverified) and $12,900 (Golden Cars, Madison).
- Toyota RAV4: 2005-2008 at $4,300-$5,200 (Madison private); 2012 Limited 161k at $4,850 (FB Madison); 2013 XLE AWD at $8,800-$9,900 (Chicago private); 2015 AWD at $10,990 (Madison); 2015 XLE 88k at $10,900 (FB Chicago). Chicago FB RAV4s at $2,999-$6,500 for 2013-2015 are bait.
- Camry: Chicago private 2012 at $4,500-$10,000, 2014 SE $4,000, 2014 Hybrid XLE $6,900, 2015 at $6,800-$9,999. Madison: 2012 $9,800, 2014 SE $8,000 (Stoughton), 2010 LE $6,800, 2009 Hybrid $7,500. Corolla: 2014 $8,700 and 2012 LE $7,490 (Madison); 2012 LE at $12,000 (Verona) is overpriced.
- Prius: 2019 with 116k at $13,400 (Madison private, new cat), 2009 at $5,000.
- Land Rover: LR2 2010-2011 at $4,995-$6,900; LR4 2011 $7,900; 2016 LR4 $10,999 vs $15,950-$16,750 (conflicting). A 2013 LR4 "bad timing chains" was listed at $1,950, which shows the failure risk. Not recommended for lowest total cost.
- Madison private-party prices for the same car often run above Chicago's (e.g., 2013 ES 350 at about $15k in Madison vs $9,250-$13,500 in Chicago). For Lexus, Chicago's northwest and west suburbs (Buffalo Grove, Schaumburg, Lemont, Streamwood) have the most private supply.
- Dates: Craigslist post IDs rise over time. ID 7857197797 was posted June 10, 2025 and ID 7927914156 on April 15, 2026, so about 0.23M IDs per day (estimate). By that rate, current Sept 2026 posts should be around 7.96B. Every CL listing found here is 5-20 months old in the search index and should be treated as a price benchmark, not live inventory. Live 捡漏 needs daily manual checks of CL and FB.

MADISON 捡漏 TACTICS (evidence-based):
1. Timing: iSeeCars (40M+ sales) found used prices fall November through March and bottom out Dec 31 to Feb 28. January has 55.6% more deals than average, MLK Day is the best holiday (+65.5%) and Presidents Day +47%. June and July are worst for buyers (up to 22.8% fewer deals; July 4 −22.4%). Source: iseecars.com/best-times-to-buy-cars-study. So an October purchase is better than summer. Selling in Aug 2027 falls in the high-price season, which suits the seller. The August influx of new UW students, including Chinese students who need cars, is an inference, not sourced.
2. Channels: madison.craigslist.org by-owner (cto) is the strongest source of private Lexus and Toyota listings. Also use FB Marketplace Madison, Milwaukee and Chicago, and the Janesville and Rockford CL sites. Chinese-language channels have weak recent inventory in the search index: the UWCSSA 麦城华人论坛 二手买卖 board (bbs.uwcssa.net fid=57, mostly older posts, e.g., 2011 Corolla 77,600 mi and 2001 Camry Solara $3,400 sold); 1point3acres 留学生买车 board (a Madison 来美半年买二手车经验贴, thread-971046); jinbay Chicago and bbs.chineseofchicago.com (mostly old 回国急售 posts). 小红书 returned nothing indexed, so search it in the app for "麦迪逊 出车" or "Madison 出车" around May graduation and July-August departures. The UWCSSA forum also has threads offering free Carfax and VIN lookups (tid=646, tid=751).
3. Auctions: Wisconsin Surplus Online Auction (Mount Horeb, 2600 STH 78 S, 608-437-2001) runs General Public Vehicle Auctions and State & Municipal Vehicle Auctions (e.g., #25-760, #25-642). A 15% buyer's fee is added to the high bid. UW-Madison SWAP says university vehicles are sold at DOA state vehicle auctions, and the state also contracts with GovDeals. Public Surplus and GovDeals list Wisconsin motor-pool items. City of Janesville also auctions surplus online. No Toyota or Lexus lots, sale prices, or current UW Credit Union or Summit CU repo lists surfaced in search, so call them directly. repofinder.com/state/wisconsin aggregates WI repos. Fleet cars are usually domestic sedans and trucks, so Toyota or Lexus lots will be rare.
4. Scams: WisDOT and the BBB warned in Feb 2025 (WMTV) of fake websites posing as real Wisconsin dealers, using fake photos and asking for wired money, with losses of $25k-$190k. Three Wisconsin people were charged with buying cars on FB Marketplace, altering odometers and titles, and reselling; about 70 cars and roughly 4.5M miles rolled back (Yahoo News). Madison police reported about six robberies tied to FB Marketplace meetups (madison.com), so meet at a police-station exchange zone. Huaren threads warn about fake VIN-report sites such as "evinreport.com", cashier's checks that bounce, and sellers who stall the title transfer. FB and OfferUp listings at 50-80% below market (e.g., 2014 RAV4 XLE $2,999, 2012 RX 350 $2,000, 2006 RAV4 $1,208 "sanitized") are down-payment bait or scams. Never wire money or pay a deposit. Match the title name to the seller's ID. Run Carfax or AutoCheck and compare the odometer history. Get a pre-purchase inspection.
5. WI title transfer (WisDOT): the seller signs and dates the title, writes the odometer reading (required on the title for model year 2011 and newer) and the selling price. The buyer signs. A lien release is needed if a lienholder is listed. The buyer applies online through eMV Public, which needs a WI driver license or ID, the last 4 of an SSN and a date of birth, and prints a temporary plate at the end. Or file form MV1 by mail (WisDOT, P.O. Box 7949, Madison WI 53707-7949) or at a DMV service center. The eMV Public SSN requirement is a hurdle for students without an SSN (inference: go in person). WI plates stay with the seller (general knowledge, not verified this run).
6. Fees (for total cost of ownership): sales tax is 5.5% in Dane County (5% state + 0.5% county), paid by the buyer at the DMV on a private sale (Avalara, PrivateAuto). The WisDOT title fee rose to $207 on Oct 1, 2025; third-party sites cite $214.50 total, likely including a $7.50 supplemental fee. Registration is $85/yr. Dane County wheel tax rises to $40 from May 1, 2026 (up from $28; WMTV and tagcostcalculator). City of Madison wheel tax is about $40 (third-party; one summary conflated it with Milwaukee's $41, so verify). Estimated first-year government fees for a Madison resident: about $214.50 + $85 + about $80 = about $380, plus 5.5% of the price (estimate). A private sale avoids dealer doc fees.
7. Chicago-area purchase: bring the signed title back and pay WI tax at WI DMV registration (inference; IL private-party tax rules not verified). Budget one day and fuel for the trip. Prices there were often $2k-$4k lower than Madison for comparable ES and RX cars.
search_coverage:
87 WebSearch calls, under the 90 cap. 1 errored because the reddit.com domain is blocked. No WebFetch or curl used. Rough breakdown:
- Craigslist Madison: about 17 searches (Lexus, RX, ES, IS, GX, RAV4, Camry/Corolla, Prius, Highlander, plus specific-post follow-ups).
- Craigslist Chicago: about 17 (RX 350, ES 350, CT 200h, RAV4, Camry, Highlander, Land Rover, plus follow-ups).
- Craigslist Milwaukee: 4. Janesville and Rockford: 1.
- Facebook Marketplace and groups: 8. OfferUp: 2. Cars.com and Autotrader private-seller: 4.
- Chinese-language: 小红书 (1, nothing indexed), UWCSSA forum (2), generic 麦迪逊/芝加哥 出车 (3), jinbay (1), chineseofchicago (1), huaren (2), 1point3acres (3).
- Auctions and repos: Wisconsin Surplus (3), City of Madison fleet (1), GovDeals/Public Surplus (1), UW SWAP (1), credit-union repos (1).
- DMV, tax and fees: 7. Scams and timing: 2.
What failed or was weak:
- Search-engine summaries of Craigslist and FB pages give prices without mileage, and item-level pages often lacked price.

market_notes:
ONLY WHAT WAS OBSERVED (aggregator averages and single listings):
- RAV4 2013, Madison: average list price $13,232, average 127,426 miles (Edmunds). The national average for a 2013 RAV4 is $12,770, starting at $6,995. Over-budget Madison examples: Smart Motors 2013 RAV4 Limited AWD, 59,105 mi, $18,498 (VIN 2T3DFREV8DW104696); a 2013 XLE with 116,466 mi flagged HIGH PRICE at $16,197.
- RAV4 2012: national average $11,040, starting at $4,888 (Cars.com). Milwaukee average mileage 131,760.
- RAV4 2014 LE: national average $14,046 (Cars.com).
- RAV4 in Chicago: 2013 average $11,975 with 148,660 mi (Edmunds); CarGurus 2013 average about $11,935. RAV4 XLE AWD, all years: average $12,715, 198 listings ranging $9,372-$39,998. 2014 LE AWD average $14,502.
- RAV4 supply in WI (CarGurus): 2015: 96 listings; 2014: 50; 2013: 62; 2012: 37.
- RAV4 price vs. miles: at or under $13.5k, WI and Chicago dealer RAV4s (2012-2015) almost all have 130k-185k miles (e.g. $10.4k-$13.4k for 130-184k). Under 110k miles at or under $13.5k is rare. The only one found is the Tri City (Menasha) 2012 RAV4 Base 4WD at 107k miles for $13,500-$13,695. Near misses just over the cap: Tri City 2013 XLE AWD 126,754 mi $13,995; AVIS Car Sales Appleton 2013 LE AWD 122,713 mi $14,595; McHenry IL 2013 XLE AWD (JTMRFREV3DD038612) about 104-113k mi $14,499; Oconomowoc 2015 RAV4 LE AWD $13,650; Jim O'Connor 2016 RAV4 LE 153,445 mi $13,580.
- Corolla: Chicago 2015 average $14,075 (Edmunds, 2,298 listings). National 2014 Corolla S average $12,738. Madison-area franchise and large-lot Corollas are pricey: Smart Motors 2016 LE 81,330 mi $15,000; Schoepp 2017 LE 105,117 mi $15,503; Farris 2017 LE 68k $15,200; Marshall WI 2017 LE 45,298 mi $16,090; Westmont IL 2016 LE 58,211 mi about $16,275; Antioch IL 2017 LE 86,505 mi $13,958; Bristol WI 2016 LE Plus 59,800 mi $14,953; Sheboygan 2015 LE 96,586 mi $14,225.
- Best Corolla outlier: Cudahy WI 2016 Corolla L, 52,652 mi, $12,999 (52 days on market).
- Camry 2012-2014 at or under $13.5k: typically $10k-$12.4k for 106k-168k miles. Just over the cap: Waukesha 2014 LE 105,022 mi $14,494; Racine 2013 LE 102,068 mi $14,197. Carvana charges big premiums for low-mileage units (2013 Camry SE 52k mi $18,990; 2014 LE 9k mi $20,990).
- Prius: 2012-2016 Prius, Prius c and Prius v run about $8.9k-$12.8k for 100-130k miles at WI dealers.
- Low-mileage Prius leads (<100k) mostly lack visible prices (Ingleside, Northbrook, Crystal Lake, Waukegan IL).
- The 2013 Prius with 82k miles at $9,795 (Madison area) has conflicting VIN data.
- Farris Auto (Cottage Grove/Stoughton): Prius start at $12,900, Corollas at $11,900.
- Budget and independent dealers worth checking:
  - Tri City Auto Sales, Menasha, (920) 282-6298: 19 Camry, 18 Prius, 17 RAV4, 9 Corolla. RAV4 from $9,995, Camry $6,995, Corolla $8,995, Prius $5,995.
  - Mad Motors, Madison, 2317 S Stoughton Rd, (608) 470-7903: Toyotas from $2,495 (7 Corolla, 4 Prius, 2 RAV4, 4 Highlander, 3 Camry).
  - Farris Auto, Cottage Grove/Stoughton: no doc or service fee, specializes in Toyota/Subaru/Honda.
  - Schoepp Motors, Madison/Middleton.
  - Jim O'Connor Select Auto, Oconomowoc.
  - Autoguys, West Allis: high-mileage hybrids with a free warranty.
  - Your Choice Autos, Elgin IL: VIN pages with prices.
- Chicago-area Autolist prices often include dealer fees.
- Private and Craigslist prices run well below dealer prices. Chicago CL shows 2012-2013 RAV4 AWD at $6.5k-$9.9k and 2014-2015 Corolla at $7.8k-$11.9k, but mileage and title are usually hidden.
- Several cheap Chicago CL ads share a 'California & Lincoln Ave' tag, which suggests one flipper or dealer.
- Some CL prices ($6.4k 2017 Camry, $6.8k 2015 Camry SE) are implausibly low, so treat them as salvage/rebuilt or scam risks.
- Facebook Marketplace Madison showed 2013-2014 Prius at $1,300-$1,400. These are almost certainly placeholder or scam prices and were not recorded as listings.
- Most listings show no posting date. Cruz.com pages appear to be about a year old.
search_coverage:
I used 99 of the 100 allowed WebSearch calls. No WebFetch or curl.

Sites and query types:
- Autolist (about 22 queries; the most productive source). City+model pages for Madison, Milwaukee, Waukesha, Wauwatosa/West Allis, Racine, Kenosha, Janesville, Appleton/Menasha, Chicago and Joliet; its summaries surface individual price and mileage listings.
- Craigslist (8 queries): Madison, Chicago, Milwaukee, Appleton, Rockford/Janesville. These returned many priced listings but rarely mileage.
- Dealer sites:
  - Schoepp Motors (4 queries): productive.
  - Your Choice Autos Elgin (1): excellent, VIN pages with prices.
  - Tri City Auto Sales (2): inventory counts only.
  - Mad Motors (3), Smart Motors / Smart Budget Cars (2), Zimbrick (1), Farris Auto (2): starting prices only.
  - Jim O'Connor Select Auto (2): productive.
- VIN-prefix and phrase technique ("2T1BURHE", "2T3BFREV", "4T1BF1FK", "for sale in ... | VIN:"), about 8 queries. It surfaced VINs in Chicago and Madison, but usually without prices.
- Individual VIN lookups: about 17. They often returned conflicting year, mileage or price (search-engine mix-ups), so prices were rarely confirmed.
- Other sources:
  - Cruz.com (2): titles include prices, but pages look stale.
  - CarGurus (4), Cars.com (3), Edmunds (2), TrueCar (1), KBB (2), CarMax (1), Carsforsale (1), Facebook (1).

What failed:
- CarMax, TrueCar, KBB, Cars.com and Carsforsale pages returned only counts and averages.
- Franchise-dealer searches (Smart Motors, Zimbrick) mostly returned newer, over-budget cars.
- The Janesville/Rockford Craigslist search returned nothing relevant.
- Multi-model or multi-city queries on Autolist were diluted; single city plus single model worked better.
- Venza, Avalon and Highlander coverage is thin: only Chicago Craigslist hits, plus Your Choice Autos' 2015 Highlander XLE at $14,999, which is over budget.

Not searched: Lexus and Land Rover (outside this task), Carvana VDPs, OfferUp, iSeeCars.
